# Vendored browser dependencies

Three.js **0.186.1**, downloaded from the official npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.186.1.tgz

- `three.module.js` and `three.core.js`: official browser ES modules.
- `OrbitControls.js`: official `examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js`.
- `BufferGeometryUtils.js`: official helper, currently unused.
- `LICENSE`: upstream MIT license; preserve when redistributing.

No runtime CDN connection or npm install is required.
